subject: Request: weekend soak top-up for POC throughput validation
messages:
From: John Perez <john.perez@brightcart.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Platform Team <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: weekend soak top-up for POC throughput validation

Hi Kimberly,

Quick ask — we’re running a controlled weekend soak for the BrightCart checkout recommender (POC) to validate p95 latency under sustained traffic. Our initial allocation is trending short based on the preflight run. Can Redwood provision an additional promo/top-up to cover ~150k tokens (~12 GPU hours) for the weekend window (Fri 22 Oct 18:00 PDT -> Mon 25 Oct 06:00 PDT)?

Scope:
- 48h soak with synthetic traffic (60 req/s peak)
- Two models: rwd-llama-13b-int8 and rwd-compat-7b-q4
- Need token-level telemetry and per-route latency tracing enabled (we’ll share the soak plan)

We’re on a tight schedule — confirmation by EOD Wed 21 Oct would help us lock the run. I attached our mutual action plan and the soak test plan (small files).

Thanks,
John Perez
Ops Lead, BrightCart

Attachments: BrightCart_POC_MAP.pdf (application/pdf), soak-test-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: John Perez <john.perez@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: weekend soak top-up for POC throughput validation

Hi John — thanks for the details and the attachments (received). A couple quick clarifying questions before I loop in Finance/Promotions for sign-off:

1) Is the POC under an active trial account or an existing paid sandbox? (I can see from the MAP it’s a trial but want to confirm)
2) Will you need model variants pinned for the full window (we can set automatic fallback to the 7b variant if capacity is constrained)
3) Can you confirm the token budget vs. concurrency target (150k tokens, but what average per-request token count are you assuming?)

If the answers match the MAP, I can request an expedited weekend top-up authorization. For transparency — typical promotional top-ups for weekend soaks are issued as a one-off token voucher plus a 72h trial extension when we need to preserve telemetry/trace access.

If you’re OK, I’ll route this to Marissa for commercial approval (cc’d).

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0124

To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, John Perez <john.perez@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: weekend soak top-up for POC throughput validation

Kimberly / John — I reviewed the MAP and soak plan. Approved to provide a one-time promo boost of 175,000 tokens plus a 72-hour trial extension to ensure BrightCart can complete the validation.

Conditions:
- Promo voucher code: RWD-BRIGHT-175K-1026 (applies only to the BrightCart trial sandbox BRIGHT-1245)
- Telemetry: enable token-level billing and per-route traces; retention will be standard trial retention (14 days) unless you want extended retention (we can quote)
- If you plan to re-run additional windows later this quarter, we should schedule a short architecture review to discuss Dedicated capacity options (can reduce unit cost).

Kimberly — please attach the voucher to the account and confirm provisioning. John — once the voucher is applied please run a smoke test and share telemetry links.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
